scope: development-page evidence design only; no implementation authorization
rank_encoding: UTF-8, pipe-separated, decimal unpadded integers, lowercase hex source hash
rank_order: SHA256 unsigned lexicographic digest bytes, then y, then x

prevalence.shortfall: min(quota, cell population); retain and report

diagnostic.deduplication: exclude prevalence and earlier selected motif anchors; walk ranked list
diagnostic.shortfall: retain; no expanded screening or replacement

presentation.crop_rule: for odd s: [x-floor(s/2),x+floor(s/2)+1) and analogous y; clip to page, no padding; separate local target coordinate
presentation.image_transform: none; optional integer nearest-neighbor viewer zoom
presentation.public_id: p followed by full lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 digest
presentation.order: ascending unsigned digest bytes, then y,x; same packet order for both annotators
presentation.collision: distinct-coordinate digest collision halts packet creation

independence.training: separate pages and coordinates excluded from all evaluation and holdout

annotation.target: anchor pixel only, source context permitted

ownership.representation: possible contributor/owner set plus unresolved boolean
ownership.unique: singleton set and unresolved false, independent attachment evidence required
ownership.shared: multiple contributors and unresolved false, independent contribution evidence required
ownership.ambiguous: unresolved true regardless of contributor set

reporting.prevalence: per-cell denominators and page-area-weighted descriptive label fractions; no generalization/CI claim
reporting.uncertainty: keep all selected rows; report missing/unknown/abstain and worst-case bounds
reporting.duplicate_anchor_error: invalidate sample; regenerate unchanged protocol, do not count as independent

stop_rules.collection: fixed quotas or documented shortfalls only
stop_rules.suppression_blocker: any musical, mixed or unknown case in proposed population
stop_rules.holdout: separately acquired multi-page source roster and hashes locked before access; candidate and failure criteria fixed before labels unseal; failure/revision needs fresh holdout

next_recommendation: offline packet builder and separate immutable evidence tables; retain guard blocking
